## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Graphs
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Graphs
//  - Graph algorithm results

//==
// # Graphs
//
// Vertex-and-edge structures and the ways they are stored: edge lists, weighted
// edge lists, dense adjacency matrices, compressed sparse row adjacency, and
// hypergraphs. Vertices are zero-based indices into an implicit
// [0, VertexCount) range; edges reference vertices by index. Edge weights are
// unit-agnostic numbers whose meaning (distance, cost, capacity) is set by the
// application.

//==
// # Core graph types

// A zero-based index of a vertex within a graph's implicit
// [0, VertexCount) vertex range. -1 means "none" (an unreachable vertex's
// parent, an unmatched pairing).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertex_(graph_theory))
type GraphVertexIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A connection between two vertices, by zero-based index. In an undirected
// graph the Source/Target order carries no meaning.
type GraphEdge
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    Source: GraphVertexIndex;
    Target: GraphVertexIndex;
}

// A graph in edge-list form. When Directed is false each edge is an unordered
// pair. Vertices without edges exist implicitly via VertexCount.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_(abstract_data_type))
type Graph
    implements IGraph
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    Edges: Array<GraphEdge>;
    Directed: Boolean;
}

// An edge carrying a numeric weight: distance, cost, capacity, or similarity,
// as the application defines (unit-agnostic).
type WeightedEdge
    implements IValue
{
    Source: GraphVertexIndex;
    Target: GraphVertexIndex;
    Weight: Number;
}

// A graph in weighted edge-list form. When Directed is false each edge is an
// unordered pair with a single shared weight.
type WeightedGraph
    implements IGraph
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    Edges: Array<WeightedEdge>;
    Directed: Boolean;
}

//==
// # Alternative graph representations

// A dense adjacency-matrix representation. Weights is row-major with
// VertexCount * VertexCount entries: entry (r, c) at index r * VertexCount + c
// is the weight of the edge from r to c, and zero means "no edge" (use weight 1
// for unweighted graphs).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adjacency_matrix)
type AdjacencyMatrix
    implements IValue
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
}

// A compressed sparse row (CSR) adjacency representation. NeighborOffsets has
// VertexCount + 1 entries; the neighbors of vertex v are
// NeighborIndices[NeighborOffsets[v]] up to (excluding)
// NeighborIndices[NeighborOffsets[v + 1]].
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adjacency_list)
type AdjacencyStructure
    implements IValue
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    NeighborOffsets: Array<Integer>;
    NeighborIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
}

// A hypergraph: edges that join any number of vertices, in CSR form.
// HyperedgeOffsets has HyperedgeCount + 1 entries; the vertices of hyperedge h
// are HyperedgeVertices[HyperedgeOffsets[h]] up to (excluding)
// HyperedgeVertices[HyperedgeOffsets[h + 1]].
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypergraph)
type Hypergraph
    implements IValue
{
    VertexCount: Integer;
    HyperedgeOffsets: Array<Integer>;
    HyperedgeVertices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
}

//==
// # Graph algorithm results
//
// The records produced by classic graph algorithms: traversals and shortest
// paths, spanning trees, components and topological orders, colorings and
// partitions, flow and matching, and vertex layouts for display. Vertices are
// zero-based indices into the source graph's implicit [0, VertexCount) range,
// and weights are unit-agnostic.

//==
// # Paths, trees, and traversal results

// A walk through a graph as an ordered vertex sequence; consecutive vertices
// are joined by edges. TotalWeight is the sum of traversed edge weights
// (unit-agnostic; equals hop count when unweighted).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Path_(graph_theory))
type GraphPath
    implements IValue
{
    VertexIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
    TotalWeight: Number;
}

// All shortest paths from one source vertex, in parent-pointer form.
// ParentIndices[v] is the predecessor of v on its shortest path (-1 for the
// source and for unreachable vertices). Distances[v] is the path weight from
// the source (meaningful only when v is the source or has a parent).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shortest-path_tree)
type ShortestPathTree
    implements IValue
{
    SourceIndex: GraphVertexIndex;
    ParentIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
    Distances: Array<Number>;
}

// A spanning tree in parent-pointer form: ParentIndices[v] is the parent of
// vertex v, and the root's parent is -1. Vertices outside the tree (disconnected
// graphs) also carry -1.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanning_tree)
type SpanningTree
    implements IValue
{
    ParentIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
    RootIndex: GraphVertexIndex;
}
```
